name: proxmox
description: Manage a Proxmox VE cluster from Claude: 324 tools for nodes, VMs, containers, storage, networking, backups and Docker inside VMs, plus guided setup, health checks, outage troubleshooting and safe-change workflows.

host.title: Proxmox host
host.description: IP address or hostname of your Proxmox server, e.g. 192.168.1.21 (port 8006 is used by default).

token_id.title: API token ID
token_id.description: Full token ID as shown in Datacenter > Permissions > API Tokens, e.g. root@pam!mcp.

token_secret.title: API token secret
token_secret.description: The token's secret (a UUID). Stored securely; never shown to Claude.

verify_ssl.title: Verify TLS certificate
verify_ssl.description: Turn on only if Proxmox has a trusted certificate. Leave off for the default self-signed one.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can change the cluster. Good for monitoring-only use.

modules.title: Tool modules (optional)
modules.description: Comma-separated list to expose fewer tools, e.g. qemu,nodes,cluster,guest-services. Leave empty for all.
